VFX & Video editing

[I work in the After Effects, Blender & Nuke]

For years, I’ve been deeply immersed in the world of video design, refining my skills with a range of powerful tools. From After Effects and Premiere Pro, to Adobe Illustrator, Blender, and Nuke, I’ve developed expertise in motion graphics, video editing, 3D modeling, and compositing. These programs have enabled me to craft visually engaging narratives and seamless visual experiences. My passion lies in bringing stories to life through the magic of moving images, using these tools to evoke emotion and create immersive visual experiences that resonate with audiences
